metric_definition: Fresh CLI process; /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size in bytes on macOS. Python perf_counter wall includes time wrapper, CLI setup, SQLite execution, CSV encoding/fsync/publication and stdout. One run per size; owned generated SQLite only. Row-by-row CSV verification and output digest calculation occur after timing and are excluded from the CLI RSS sample. First binary launch was the 6000-row case; OS cache/signature warmup was not controlled. Wall times are single observations, not throughput comparisons. No concurrent builds/benchmarks. Not a hard memory bound for arbitrary SQLite queries.

cases.sql: WITH RECURSIVE n(v) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT v+1 FROM n WHERE v<6000) SELECT v AS id, printf('%0100d',v) AS payload FROM n
